sampling_model.design: Population identification uses a square fully observed cyclic LiNG model with independent nondegenerate errors and at most one Gaussian coordinate. Inference uses independent observations from one fixed law in the FOBI subclass, whose eigengaps are gaps among distinct centered standardized fourth cumulants.
sampling_model.units: The observations \(X_1,\ldots,X_m\) are independent draws from one fixed \(q\)-variate equilibrium law.
sampling_model.treatment: There is no treatment variable in the core identification theorem. In the downstream Sharifian--Salehkaleybar--Kiyavash design problem, an atomic intervention reveals a matching edge; their unfiltered matching formulation does not assume stability, which is additionally imposed only for the counted equilibrium-stable subfamily considered here.
sampling_model.overlap: No propensity-score overlap condition is used.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: The sample covariance whitens the observations, the sample FOBI eigensystem estimates row directions, and the plug-in influence functions calibrate a symmetrized matrix region. Because empirical eigenvector signs may change, covariance consistency is asserted only modulo signed-row conjugacy. Coverage and contraction are pointwise; no graph support is assumed known, and no uniform claim is made near vanishing FOBI eigengaps, zero normalization denominators, or unit-circle stability boundaries.

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: LiNG-D outputs the complete distribution-entailment equivalence class and stability selects at most one candidate when the true graph has disjoint cycles.
Distribution-equivalent cyclic LiNG graphs correspond to perfect matchings, their SCCs are invariant, and unfiltered matching samples estimate intervention reward.
The permanent of every nonnegative matrix has a fully polynomial randomized approximation scheme.
Counting independent sets is \(\#\mathrm P\)-complete even for graphs of maximum degree three.
At hard-core activity one, independent-set counting on graphs of maximum degree at most five has a deterministic fully polynomial-time approximation scheme.
Unless \(\mathrm{NP}=\mathrm{RP}\), no FPRAS counts independent sets on graphs of maximum degree six.
All perfect matchings of a bipartite graph can be enumerated in output-sensitive total time with linear work per matching after preprocessing.
Under bounded eighth moments and distinct kurtoses, the FOBI unmixing estimator has an explicit joint root-sample-size expansion.
Inversion of a sample criterion yields confidence regions for an identified parameter set with consistency and coverage theory.
Discontinuity of a functional prevents nontrivial locally uniform confidence procedures in general.
StableSpIn learns cyclic linear models under the absolute spectral-radius restriction \(\rho(|B|)<1\).

body.tldr: A fully observed cyclic LiNG law identifies a finite monomial row-assignment orbit, while additionally imposed equilibrium stability applies a global spectral filter. The explicit rational \(3n\)-variable construction \(W_G\) has complete stable orbit \(\{\pi_S:S\in\mathcal I(G)\}\). On its fixed-labelled bounded-degree images, exact stable counting is in \(\mathrm{FP}\) through degree two and \(\#\mathrm P\)-complete already at degree three; approximation has a deterministic \(\mathrm{FPTAS}\) through degree five and no \(\mathrm{FPRAS}\) at degree six unless \(\mathrm{RP}=\mathrm{NP}\). The unfiltered orbit remains a permanent with an FPRAS. Algebraic SCC factorization holds for arbitrary real equation matrices, while the exact output-sensitive local enumerator and all bit-complexity guarantees remain restricted to rational stable-reference inputs. Symmetrized FOBI-region inversion gives pointwise orbit-honest count coverage without a uniform graph-support or stability-boundary claim.

project_justification.gap: Published cyclic-LiNG methods identify, enumerate, or sample the full normalized perfect-matching fiber and may screen candidates by stability, but they do not classify the stability-filtered count, its sharp bounded-degree exact and approximation transitions, or the validity of transferring permanent-based guarantees after the spectral filter is imposed.
project_justification.niche: The missing bridge was a coefficient-valid rational realization controlling normalization, every unintended assignment, analytic multiplicity, absence of Schur-complement poles, and polynomial-bit stability margins, together with a lossless recovery map that imports the degree-two/three exact and degree-five/six approximation thresholds.
project_justification.fill: The graph gadget identifies its complete stable assignment orbit with independent sets and transfers the sharp bounded-degree phase diagram: exact \(\mathrm{FP}\) for degree at most two, exact \(\#\mathrm P\)-completeness at degree three, a deterministic \(\mathrm{FPTAS}\) through degree five, and no \(\mathrm{FPRAS}\) at degree six unless \(\mathrm{RP}=\mathrm{NP}\). The note also proves admissible and stable SCC product decompositions for arbitrary real equation matrices, retains an exact local enumerator that is output-sensitive in local admissible matching fibers only on rational stable-reference inputs, and gives pointwise symmetrized FOBI confidence-image coverage.

body.related_work: Lacerda, Spirtes, Ramsey, and Hoyer characterize the cyclic-LiNG row-permutation fiber and use Schur stability to screen candidates, but do not realize arbitrary independent-set systems. Sharifian, Salehkaleybar, and Kiyavash represent distribution-equivalent cyclic LiNG graphs by perfect matchings, establish SCC invariance, and estimate intervention rewards from unfiltered matching samples; they do not assume equilibrium stability, so the stable orbit here is an additionally restricted consumer subfamily. Jerrum, Sinclair, and Vigoda give the permanent FPRAS for that unfiltered benchmark. Greenhill proves exact independent-set counting \(\#\mathrm P\)-complete already for degree-three regular graphs; Weitz gives a deterministic hard-core \(\mathrm{FPTAS}\) at activity one through maximum degree five; and Sly rules out an FPRAS at maximum degree six unless \(\mathrm{RP}=\mathrm{NP}\). Those sources provide the donor thresholds, while the present fixed-labelled coefficient construction and recovery map prove their lossless transfer to stable cyclic-LiNG orbit counting. The FOBI limit uses distinct centered standardized fourth cumulants and covariance convergence only modulo signed-row conjugacy.
body.technical_internal_limitation: The graph-uniform analytic proof uses deliberately conservative contour and resolvent constants; finite complete-orbit checks are sanity checks rather than substitutes for that proof. All counting lower-bound inputs are explicit rational matrices with polynomial total encoding length and a stable reference. SCC product factorization is purely algebraic and applies to arbitrary real equation matrices, but the local enumeration runtime, Lyapunov certificates, and bit-complexity statements remain confined to rational stable-reference inputs and are output-sensitive in local admissible matching fibers, not stable outputs alone. The phase diagram is for the fixed-labelled gadget images, and it asserts neither an almost-uniform stable sampler nor stability-conditioned adaptive submodularity. FOBI count-region coverage remains pointwise, with no uniformity at graph-support, eigengap, normalization, or unit-circle boundaries.
body.honest_scope: The proved contribution is the explicit rational stable-orbit realization, its one-call counting separation, and the sharp bounded-degree phase diagram on recoverable gadget images. The lower bounds hold on a strict safe subclass with a stable reference and independent centered variance-one continuous non-Gaussian errors, so they transfer upward to the rationally encoded published cyclic-LiNG/perfect-matching class; this does not attribute stability to the unfiltered matching model. Admissible and stable orbit factorization holds for arbitrary real equation matrices, whereas exact certification and output-sensitive local enumeration remain restricted to rational stable-reference inputs. No almost-uniform stable generator, certificate-hardness theorem, uniform graph-support recovery theorem, or stability-conditioned adaptive-submodularity result is claimed. FOBI inference is pointwise and orbit-honest only.
body.interpretation: The causal object is the number of Schur-stable mechanisms in the population-identified normalized ICA row orbit, not an arbitrary count attached to one ICA labeling and not an effect estimand. On the gadget image, theorem rather than definition proves \(N_{\mathrm{stab}}(W_G)=|\mathcal I(G)|\), and the labelled coefficients recover \(G\) in polynomial time. The resulting degree-two/three exact elbow and degree-five/six approximation elbow therefore transfer without loss. Matching frequencies and adaptive intervention scores in the downstream cyclic-LiNG design problem must be conditioned on the stable orbit whenever equilibrium stability is additionally imposed; the permanent FPRAS for all admissible assignments does not itself approximate those stability-conditioned quantities.
